title: Noah's ark compared in length with Santa Maria, Titanic and Queen Mary II
summary: A scale from 100 to 1200 ft. with the names Santa Maria, Noah's Ark, Titanic and Queen Mary II laid out beneath it, each name stretched to a different length so the ships can be compared in size against the scale.

text.text: T I T A N I C

pictures.description: A horizontal length scale in feet from 100 to 1200 with tick marks along the top. Beneath it the ship names are written in increasing length: Santa Maria (red and yellow), NOAH'S ARK (N and O green, A and R red, rest black), TITANIC (grey) and QUEEN MARY II (black), the widest.
pictures.text_in_picture: 100 200 300 400 500 600 700 800 900 1000 1100 1200 ft. Santa Maria NOAH'S ARK TITANIC QUEEN MARY II

uncertain: Ship lengths are not stated as numbers; the name labels' widths against the scale are the only indication of size.
